name: Classic Sloppy Joes with Zesty Broccoli Slaw

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onions. Wash, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
3 red bell peppers
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion and peppers. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add beef and garlic. Breaking apart with a spoon, cook until meat is browned and crumbly, 2-3 minutes.
Add tomato sauce, vinegar, honey, Worcestershire, Dijon, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Stirring occasionally, reduce heat to low and simmer until sauce thickens, 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tbsp honey
1 ½ tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
3 tsp Dijon mustard
3 tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Toast buns or rolls if desired.
To serve, fill buns or rolls with sloppy joe mixture and enjoy with broccoli slaw on the side!
